steps.title: Barrel: a tube
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).ipt and save it as barrel.ipt.
Start 2D Sketch on the YZ Plane. Two circles on the origin: diameter 36 and diameter 32. Finish Sketch.
Extrude: click inside the ring so only the ring is picked. Distance A: 80 mm. Click OK.

steps.title: Rear cap: square end plate
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).ipt and save it as rear_cap.ipt.
Sketch a 44 by 44 Rectangle (Two Point Center) on the YZ Plane and Extrude it 12 mm.
Fillet: radius 3 mm on the four edges along the thickness. Click OK.

steps.title: Rear cap: air port
actions: Click Hole and click a side face of the cap, half way through its 12 mm thickness and in the middle.
Simple Hole. Diameter 6 mm. Through All. Click OK. Save rear_cap.ipt.
steps.note: This is the port where the air comes in on the cylinder symbol.

steps.title: Front cap with rod hole
actions: Make front_cap.ipt the same way: 44 by 44 square, Extrude 12 mm, Fillet 3 mm.
Hole on the centre of the face. Simple Hole. Diameter 13 mm. Through All. Click OK.

steps.title: Piston and piston rod
actions: piston.ipt: Circle diameter 31 on the YZ Plane, Extrude 10 mm.
rod.ipt: Circle diameter 12 on the YZ Plane, Extrude 122 mm.

steps.title: Return spring
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).ipt and save it as spring.ipt.
Start 2D Sketch on the XY Plane. Draw a centre line along the X axis, and a circle of diameter 2.4 with its centre 11 from the line. Finish Sketch.
Click Coil. Profile: the circle. Axis: the centre line.
Coil Size tab: Type Pitch and Height. Pitch 7.71 mm, Height 54 mm (7 turns). Click OK.

steps.title: Assembly: barrel and caps
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).iam and save it as pneumatic_cylinder.iam.
Place barrel.ipt and right click, Place Grounded at Origin.
Place rear_cap.ipt and front_cap.ipt. For each: Constrain > Mate the cap face to the end of the barrel, then Mate the cap centre axis to the barrel axis.

steps.title: Assembly: piston and rod
actions: Place piston.ipt and rod.ipt.
Constrain > Insert: the rod end into the piston face, so they share an axis.
Constrain > Mate: the piston axis to the barrel axis, and the back of the piston 6 mm from the rear cap.

steps.title: Assembly: the spring
actions: Place spring.ipt.
Constrain > Mate: the spring axis to the rod axis.
Constrain > Mate: one end of the spring against the front of the piston. Save the assembly.
steps.note: Spring return: air pushes the piston out, and the spring pushes it back when the air is let out.
